name: Advisor Role Gating + Data Tier Transmission
description: Layer a second-dimension `advisorRole` gate on top of the existing admin/user firmRole gate so a partner-firm user's Book view depth is driven by their RCU role. Frontend gating is cosmetic; backend tiered data transmission is the trust boundary (ARCHITECTURE.md Principle 2). Four-role enum (architect / consultant / local_ops / implementor) with payload strip in opal-partners-data Lambda for L1 implementor (no `clients[]` + no cost-basis/tax/income), L2 client/account drill restricted to architect, cross-advisor drill admin-exclusive. Initial target firm: 49 Financial.
